skill.summary: Calendario fiscal argentino completo para ARCA (ex AFIP). Responde preguntas sobre vencimientos impositivos y previsionales para PyMEs, autónomos, monotribut...

latestVersion.changelog: Initial public release. Complete fiscal calendar for ARCA covering Monotributo, Autónomos, IVA, Ganancias, SUSS/F.931, Bienes Personales, Servicio Doméstico, and SIRADIG. Includes CUIT-ending lookup rules, holiday-shift logic per Decreto 614/2025, and 2026 special dates. Validated against official ARCA sources.
